import numpy as np
np.random.seed(17)

# Generate G(200, 0.3) with seed=17
n = 200
p = 0.3
edges = []
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        if np.random.random() < p:
            edges.append((i, j))

# Build adjacency list
adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
for i, j in edges:
    adj[i].append(j)
    adj[j].append(i)

# Use greedy local search starting from a good initial partition
# Initialize with a balanced random partition
np.random.seed(42)  # Different seed for initialization
partition = np.random.randint(0, 2, n)

# Ensure roughly balanced partition
if sum(partition) > n//2 + 10:
    indices = np.where(partition == 1)[0]
    flip_count = sum(partition) - n//2
    flip_indices = np.random.choice(indices, flip_count, replace=False)
    partition[flip_indices] = 0
elif sum(partition) < n//2 - 10:
    indices = np.where(partition == 0)[0]
    flip_count = n//2 - sum(partition)
    flip_indices = np.random.choice(indices, flip_count, replace=False)
    partition[flip_indices] = 1

# Local search improvement
def calculate_cut_value(partition):
    cut = 0
    for i, j in edges:
        if partition[i] != partition[j]:
            cut += 1
    return cut

def local_improvement(partition):
    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        current_cut = calculate_cut_value(partition)
        
        for v in range(n):
            # Try flipping vertex v
            old_val = partition[v]
            partition[v] = 1 - old_val
            new_cut = calculate_cut_value(partition)
            
            if new_cut > current_cut:
                current_cut = new_cut
                improved = True
            else:
                partition[v] = old_val
    
    return partition

# Apply local search
partition = local_improvement(partition)

# Try multiple restarts with different initializations
best_partition = partition.copy()
best_cut = calculate_cut_value(best_partition)

for restart in range(5):
    np.random.seed(100 + restart)
    new_partition = np.random.randint(0, 2, n)
    
    # Balance the partition
    if sum(new_partition) > n//2 + 10:
        indices = np.where(new_partition == 1)[0]
        flip_count = sum(new_partition) - n//2
        flip_indices = np.random.choice(indices, flip_count, replace=False)
        new_partition[flip_indices] = 0
    elif sum(new_partition) < n//2 - 10:
        indices = np.where(new_partition == 0)[0]
        flip_count = n//2 - sum(new_partition)
        flip_indices = np.random.choice(indices, flip_count, replace=False)
        new_partition[flip_indices] = 1
    
    new_partition = local_improvement(new_partition)
    new_cut = calculate_cut_value(new_partition)
    
    if new_cut > best_cut:
        best_partition = new_partition.copy()
        best_cut = new_cut
